rawIngestions.titleRaw: anthropics/claude-code v2.1.327 released
rawIngestions.contentRaw:
## What's changed

- Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository
- Added `claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
- Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded
- Added a list in `/status` of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match
- Added a note in `/config` when other settings override a row
- Added `x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum` to the gateway hint headers; sent where managed settings set `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`, including where they already do
- Added support for naming a session's billing group with the `attributionProject` setting, for Claude apps gateways that set `admin.billing_group_tag`
- Added `/tui classic` as the name for the non-fullscreen renderer; `/tui default` still works
- Remote Control: Fixed stopping the server in worktree mode deleting a running session's git-ignored files, such as `.env`
- Fixed self-hosted runners with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` deleting a non-empty directory named by `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` at startup: the runner now keeps it, ignores the variable and warns
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `claude mcp remove` with project scope deleting other top-level keys from `.mcp.json`, such as `$schema` or another tool's `servers`
- Fixed `/export` overwriting an existing file without asking: the dialog now asks, and `/export <name>` keeps the file and says to run `/export`
- Fixed a command you had allowed still running after you pressed Stop, when the approval arrived after a restart, in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions with no feature flags loaded
- Fixed Enter closing `/teleport`'s load error screen
- Fixed a click followed by Enter in `/plugin` installing or disabling a plugin
- Fixed a half-typed `!` command running on an extra Enter after the usage limit menu
- Fixed some `--disallowedTools` rules with parentheses in their content
- Fixed auto mode ignoring some wildcard PowerShell allow rules that name a script with `.\`, such as `PowerShell(.\scripts\build.ps1 *)`
- Fixed a running Code Mode script in auto mode getting permission prompts and denials once Claude started a second script that auto mode also allowed
- Changed some pre-started background sessions to be discarded after an account change
- Changed a workflow paused at a usage limit in the terminal to stay paused after a login, until the earlier login returns or you type a prompt
- Fixed a nested `claude` with its own token being refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID`: commands that don't get the session's token no longer get its `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`; set it on any that need it
- Fixed headless sessions losing stored messages on resume when a message was sent again with the same UUID after the process was killed
- Fixed cases where a session resumed after an empty reply or a killed command lost an answer, or brought back a rewound prompt, after another crash or a move to the background
- Fixed a remote session forgetting messages sent after Stop was pressed during a restart, if Claude Code then crashed
- Fixed tasks created after `/clear` being lost, and cleared tasks coming back, when a cloud or self-hosted runner session with no feature flags loaded resumed later
- Fixed a compaction right after a reply cut at the output token limit losing that reply's tool call and its result
- Fixed a settings change from `/config` and similar commands failing to save with no warning; a line under the prompt now says so
- Fixed `/rewind` closing without a word when some files could not be restored
- Fixed pasted images being dropped when the prompt starts with a file path such as `/tmp/a.txt`
- Fixed agents passed with `--agents` being lost once plugins loaded or reloaded
- Fixed a plugin's agent being dropped when resuming a session from the `--resume` picker
- Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when `https_proxy` or `HTTPS_PROXY` is a bare `host:port` and neither its input nor its output is a terminal (the desktop app, an SDK, cron)
- Fixed Claude Code on Linux sometimes returning to the shell while restarting itself at startup, such as after the first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway or when turning on Code Mode
- Fixed `claude -p` hanging before its first request when the fetch of a model's settings stalled, such as at a proxy; it now goes on without them after 10 seconds
- Fixed the screen staying blank or frozen after a brief out-of-memory error
- Fixed a rare display fault that could freeze the screen or end the session
- Fixed cloud sessions breaking when a program left thousands of connections open to the session's network proxy
- Fixed a turn hanging when a mod's `$.model.complete` or `$.model.classify` call met a usage limit: the call now gets the API's error at once; mods should handle that error
- Fixed stalls on a compaction reply with thousands of unclosed tags and on some very long WebFetch URLs; WebFetch now refuses a URL over 2,000 characters before any permission prompt
- Fixed a message with thousands of `@` mentions stalling before Claude replies; only the first 100 mentions are now looked up as files
- Fixed the prompt freezing after rejecting a write to a very large file; a rejected write now shows a short preview
- Fixed a crash when a burst of keys reached the search box in `/plugin`
- Fixed a false crash report and exit code when a suspended session resumes, or at exit, where a Linux security policy blocks a process from signalling itself
- Fixed remote MCP servers staying disconnected after a longer outage such as a VPN drop: most servers on other machines reached by hostname over https are now retried in the background for about a day
- Fixed Edit refusing with "File has not been read yet" after a compaction on unchanged files outside the project that Claude had already read in full
- Fixed Grep repeating or skipping results when paging with `head_limit` and `offset`; content and count results are now sorted by file path
- Fixed Read failing on Jupyter notebooks that contain an output of an unknown type
- Fixed NotebookEdit removing the notebook file's final newline
- Fixed the Read tool reporting 512KB instead of the real size when a file of 10 MB or more is too large to read at once
- Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files not naming files that are binary, too large or too many to show
- Fixed artifact publishes failing with "the source file changed between approval and publish" when a synced or remote-backed folder had only changed the file's timestamp
- Fixed a new artifact that you approved being refused in a cloud scheduled task's session, in organizations that require approval of each new artifact
- Fixed a new artifact being refused after an app built on the Agent SDK approved it, in organizations that require approval of each new artifact
- Fixed `/artifacts` showing part of your list, or "No artifacts yet", when a request for more of the list failed: it now tries again, then warns if it can't load the whole list
- Fixed in-process agent teammates on a different model from the lead compacting at the lead's context limit and on the wrong model; they now use their own limit and model, at that model's rate
- Fixed a finished subagent resuming on the model and effort of a sibling subagent that messaged it
- Fixed the main conversation not being told a background agent had finished when the subagent that started it ended by itself without reading the result, outside auto mode
- Fixed Claude reporting a background agent as still running when it had waited 30 seconds or more on a permission prompt in the desktop app, on the web and in the SDK
- Fixed Claude not being told in auto mode when a background agent's reply to a follow-up message was dropped, and reduced repeat wake-ups there from agents waiting on background commands
- Fixed the desktop app, Claude Code on the web and VS Code showing a raw task notification as a subagent's prompt after its background task woke it
- Fixed messages sent from another session with "later" priority joining the running turn, instead of waiting for it to end, in Remote Control and Claude Desktop sessions
- Fixed messages to cloud and Remote Control sessions being reported as failed with a stale address after a timeout or rate limit; Claude now says when a message may have arrived
- Fixed cloud sessions giving no error when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocks a message sent while Claude works
- Fixed failing hooks showing nothing: SubagentStop in background agents, SessionEnd at `/clear` and `/resume`, and CwdChanged and FileChanged in fullscreen
- Fixed a Stop hook that failed to run being shown as having reported a problem
- Fixed focus view keeping a finished reply hidden while a Stop hook was running
- Fixed Claude getting a long managed PostToolUse hook output twice when a mod added context to the tool call
- Fixed `/model` listing the wrong models in some terminal sessions when a project's `.claude/settings.json` sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to an LLM gateway
- Fixed `/statusline` writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` points to another folder
- Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` patterns on Windows not matching a path whose drive letter is written in the other case
- Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to remove a fully pushed session ("The worktree has unpushed commits") when its worktree has a file or folder named `HEAD` at the top level
- Fixed long ListAgents results hiding most sessions on accounts with many cloud or Remote Control sessions: long lists now come in pages
- Fixed slow turns in resumed sessions for organizations with tens of thousands of connector tool permissions
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed `claude -p` started by a session's script or hook waiting out rate limits, because it inherited the session's own retry setting
- Fixed the spend limit menu reporting a changed limit when the server refused it
- Fixed a second `x` on a task's details in `/tasks` stopping the next task too
- Fixed Esc being ignored on a permission prompt that had just appeared
- Fixed lists that load their rows late sometimes ignoring Enter and the arrow keys
- Fixed `/autofix-pr` holding the keyboard after Esc while it stopped the cloud session; the dialog now closes at once, and a stop that fails is reported afterwards with a link
- Fixed a blank screen and stray mouse codes in the shell after quitting with ctrl+c just after ← opens the agents view
- Fixed Ctrl+C right after the trust question leaving the terminal in fullscreen
- Fixed the shell flashing on screen when ← opens the agents view in fullscreen mode
- Fixed terminal display faults: most scrambled scrollback in Ghostty on resize, link addresses hidden in Windows Terminal under old tmux and in VTE 0.50.0, and no selection highlight with 16 colors
- Fixed some garbled rows in tmux with `allow-passthrough` on inside kitty, Ghostty or iTerm2
- Fixed `/mcp` saying no servers were configured after one was added during a session or declined; it now says what to do
- Fixed `/hooks` leaving out hooks given by `--settings`
- Fixed the `/` menu listing a row for each skill of the same name, though every row ran the first
- Fixed `/teleport` showing no message when the chosen session failed to resume
- Fixed n and N in transcript search skipping matches
- Fixed cancelling a transcript search (ctrl+o, then /) in a long session landing far from where the search started
- Fixed up and down losing the cursor's column over a short or blank line
- Fixed Tab in shell mode filling in a file name after `&&`, `;` or `|`, where a command goes
- Fixed the selected session leaving the screen in `claude --resume` and `/resume` when branch names or folder paths are long
- Fixed the MCP tool list in `/mcp` and `/plugin` losing your place when going back from a tool
- Fixed `/resume` listing one session fewer than the window has room for, and a 'Resend your message' hint after most spend caps, where resending can't help
- Fixed an MCP server's long question being cut off after one row, text fields hiding long pastes with no sign, and a doubled divider line in `/plugin`'s options and `/login`'s Bedrock and Vertex steps
- Fixed the "+N lines" count being too high for command output with links or colors, and the transcript's `?` help hiding how to exit in a short window
- Fixed Ctrl+C twice not closing `/chrome` from its browser list
- Fixed a number and Enter typed too early at an agent's plan approval in screen reader mode causing the next number to be dropped too
- Fixed Claude trying to read design system token files that do not exist when starting a deck or design
- Fixed exit not saying that a worktree was kept
- Fixed `/hooks` help naming input fields that do not exist
- Fixed question dialogs naming ctrl+g after the external editor key was rebound
- Fixed two sign-in error messages that pointed to the Claude subscription option on computers where `forceLoginMethod` is set to `console`
- Fixed `/config` saying the dialog was dismissed instead of "Set theme to …" after changing the theme
- Bug fixes and reliability improvements
- Improved the speed of a session's first Bash command: shell start-up files may now run before it's approved, even if it's refused; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` to turn this off
- Improved commits on newer models and in PowerShell: Claude is now told not to commit files that likely contain secrets
- Improved sandboxed shell commands: Claude now sees when a command exempt from the sandbox stayed in it because its permission check relied on the sandbox
- Improved the refusal for shell commands with no `rm` that the dangerous `rm` check can't parse, so Claude can resend harmless ones in plain syntax instead of giving up
- Improved resuming very long sessions: a transcript read that ends early is now retried once, so messages are lost less often
- Improved subagent answers that hit the output token limit twice: they now more often come back whole or say up front that they are partial
- Improved long replies on unrecognized models: a reply cut at 32,000 output tokens now continues with a limit of 128,000
- Improved the reminder about a completed subagent after compaction: if Claude can't read the agent's output file, it is now told to ask the agent with `SendMessage`
- Improved the warning shown when an API key and an Anthropic profile are both set: it now says which one is in use and how to switch to the profile
- Improved `/plugin`: the question before removing a marketplace now says that its plugins' settings and saved data are deleted, and a marketplace's page no longer shows another marketplace's error
- Windows: Improved start-up time with no Git Bash and no `pwsh` on PATH by checking PowerShell's standard install locations at once; System32's `powershell.exe` now wins over one earlier on PATH
- Improved startup time on Windows when PATH points to Git for Windows' bin folder, by starting git.exe directly instead of through its launcher
- Windows: Improved PowerShell tool speed by up to about half a second per command
- Improved how soon the Bash tool's diff of changed files is ready in auto and bypass permissions modes
- Improved speed of the Bash permission check on very deeply nested missing paths on macOS and Linux, and of secret masking on very long text with a URL
- Improved transcript search to find text in edits and written files
- Improved speed of reading large PNG images, and the quality of the JPEG sent in their place
- Improved the Artifact tool to read an uploaded file by the address the artifact's page shows; other forms still fail, most with a message that says to read uploads one per call, by id
- Improved the Artifact tool to ignore `prompt`, `limit` and `label` on some calls that do not use them instead of failing the call
- Improved MCP server pages in `/mcp`: local, remote and agent servers share one layout, menus end in Back, and actions are no longer numbered outside screen reader mode; use the arrow keys and Enter
- Improved narrow terminals: `/status`, forms and detail screens lay out better, `/model` and `/effort` fit at about 40 columns, and key hints such as `←/→ to adjust` stay
- Improved `/install-github-app`: the repository, secret and API key steps use the standard list and keys, with shorter messages, a spinner and clearer errors
- Improved `/desktop`: the download question is a standard list instead of y/n
- Changed `ExitWorktree` to ask before removing a worktree that may hold unsaved work; refused in don't-ask mode or with nobody to answer, unless an allow rule, auto or bypass permissions mode allows it
- Changed `claude mcp add --scope project` to stop, instead of overwriting the file, when `.mcp.json` lists its servers at the top level with no `mcpServers` key
- Changed the arrow keys on most permission prompts to stop at No instead of wrapping around; a number past the last answer moves to No
- Changed path checks to refuse some symbolic links
- Changed what counts as inside a working directory, so some paths now ask for permission
- Changed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to ask about more Bash commands in bypass and auto modes, and to deny some in auto mode
- Changed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to refuse more Bash commands that name a path under a Read or Edit deny rule, where it used to ask
- Changed auto mode's notice about falling back to billed classifier requests to say that an upcoming release removes the fallback; each action it would have checked will be asked about or denied
- Changed auto mode to ignore more allow rules that run any package, like `Bash(pnpm dlx *)`, and path or version forms of ones it already ignored (`/usr/bin/npm run:*`); the safety check decides those
- Changed `/sandbox` and most `/config` value lists to be unnumbered outside screen reader mode; use the arrow keys and Enter
- Changed Bash commands whose variables expand to very long text to be denied, with a message that says to use shorter values or a file
- Changed the PowerShell tool to ask before one more command, even under a rule naming it; if nothing answers, it's refused unless a whole-tool rule, auto mode or bypass permissions mode allows it
- Changed a subagent resumed by a sibling's message to follow the session's permission settings; it may now ask, or be refused where nobody can answer
- Changed `--worktree` with a relative `--add-dir` beside the launch folder to give the Bash sandbox that folder, not one beside the worktree
- Changed some `--worktree` starts with a relative `--add-dir` above the launch folder, such as `..`, to give the Bash sandbox, and a `--bg` session, only the worktree
- Changed Claude in Chrome to refuse uploading some credential files; attach those to the page yourself
- Changed artifact approval in organizations that require it for each new artifact: an artifact that only a plugin created or allowed can be refused
- Changed sessions with nobody to ask to refuse a new artifact at once, with no permission prompt, in organizations that require approval of each one
- Changed the Artifact tool to refuse calls once settings turn Artifacts off, in sessions already running too
- Changed the Artifact publish prompt to stop offering "don't ask again" in subagents and after a background task result, someone else's message or a compaction
- Changed `claude plugin eval` to keep its deny rules over a plugin's permission hook, and to flag calls the hook let through
- Changed MCP server logs to record the mode, action, and field names of elicitation requests and hook answers, not their full contents
- Changed most prompts to ignore answers other than Esc for a moment after resuming with `fg`
- Changed Code Mode to no longer refuse to start when an installed mod hooks tool calls; an administrator can still keep Code Mode off in managed settings
- Changed subagents launched without a model to stay on the model they started on when resumed, including after `/model`
- Changed the first subagent on a model to wait up to 1.5 seconds (10 in `claude -p`) for that model's settings from Anthropic, instead of starting without them
- Changed restarted background subagents, and turns that start by themselves, to wait for plugins to load
- Changed prompt history to leave out most launch prompts of sessions that another Claude Code session started, such as `claude --bg` run by Claude
- Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to be written from short notes, not the whole conversation, using far fewer tokens
- Changed non-interactive (`-p`) mode to run fewer git commands before the first request
- Changed first-run setup to skip terminal setup in remote VS Code, Cursor and Devin Desktop sessions, where it cannot change settings
- Changed fullscreen text selection to leave out the glyph of system, thinking and inbound message lines
- Changed Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to ignore more of a repository's flag and plugin delivery settings; its `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` now acts at most as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
- [VSCode] Added "Claude Code: Add to Chat" to the Explorer's right-click menu, which @-mentions the selected files and folders in the chat
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt not showing the reason that a PreToolUse hook gives when it asks for confirmation (anthropics/claude-code#85950)
- [VSCode] Fixed long tool and file names being cut off in a permission prompt's title
- [VSCode] Fixed a terminal session's diff showing the previous proposed edit after you typed in it and Claude edited the same file again
- [VSCode] Fixed Escape also stopping Claude's response when it closes the feedback or "Build a custom style" dialog, the @-mention menu, the model, mode or "+" menu, or another popup
- [VSCode] Improved speed when Claude makes several edits in a row: queued edits share one wait for new problems; a problem may be reported with a later edit
- [VSCode] Improved @-mention file search speed in large workspaces when `rg` is on your `PATH`; results now rank much as in the terminal, with less tolerance for typos
- [VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker is ready at once in folders opened for the first time, empty windows and worktrees, except on third-party providers
- [VSCode] Changed a chat edit's diff to stay open and keep asking for approval when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt
- [VSCode] Removed unused tools from the IDE connection (openFile, saveDocument, getOpenEditors and related)

- Fixed exit not saying that a worktree was kept
- Fixed `/hooks` help naming input fields that do not exist
- Fixed question dialogs naming ctrl+g after the external editor key was rebound
- Fixed two sign-in error messages that pointed to the Claude subscription option on computers where `forceLoginMethod` is set to `console`
- Fixed `/config` saying the dialog was dismissed instead of "Set theme to …" after changing the theme
- Bug fixes and reliability improvements
- Improved the speed of a session's first Bash command: shell start-up files may now run before it's approved, even if it's refused; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` to turn this off
- Improved commits on newer models and in PowerShell: Claude is now told not to commit files that likely contain secrets
- Improved sandboxed shell commands: Claude now sees when a command exempt from the sandbox stayed in it because its permission check relied on the sandbox
- Improved the refusal for shell commands with no `rm` that the dangerous `rm` check can't parse, so Claude can resend harmless ones in plain syntax instead of giving up
- Improved resuming very long sessions: a transcript read that ends early is now retried once, so messages are lost less often
- Improved subagent answers that hit the output token limit twice: they now more often come back whole or say up front that they are partial
- Improved long replies on unrecognized models: a reply cut at 32,000 output tokens now continues with a limit of 128,000
- Improved the reminder about a completed subagent after compaction: if Claude can't read the agent's output file, it is now told to ask the agent with `SendMessage`
- Improved the warning shown when an API key and an Anthropic profile are both set: it now says which one is in use and how to switch to the profile
- Improved `/plugin`: the question before removing a marketplace now says that its plugins' settings and saved data are deleted, and a marketplace's page no longer shows another marketplace's error
- Windows: Improved start-up time with no Git Bash and no `pwsh` on PATH by checking PowerShell's standard install locations at once; System32's `powershell.exe` now wins over one earlier on PATH
- Improved startup time on Windows when PATH points to Git for Windows' bin folder, by starting git.exe directly instead of through its launcher
- Windows: Improved PowerShell tool speed by up to about half a second per command
- Improved how soon the Bash tool's diff of changed files is ready in auto and bypass permissions modes
- Improved speed of the Bash permission check on very deeply nested missing paths on macOS and Linux, and of secret masking on very long text with a URL
- Improved transcript search to find text in edits and written files
- Improved speed of reading large PNG images, and the quality of the JPEG sent in their place
- Improved the Artifact tool to read an uploaded file by the address the artifact's page shows; other forms still fail, most with a message that says to read uploads one per call, by id
- Improved the Artifact tool to ignore `prompt`, `limit` and `label` on some calls that do not use them instead of failing the call
- Improved MCP server pages in `/mcp`: local, remote and agent servers share one layout, menus end in Back, and actions are no longer numbered outside screen reader mode; use the arrow keys and Enter
- Improved narrow terminals: `/status`, forms and detail screens lay out better, `/model` and `/effort` fit at about 40 columns, and key hints such as `←/→ to adjust` stay
- Improved `/install-github-app`: the repository, secret and API key steps use the standard list and keys, with shorter messages, a spinner and clearer errors
- Improved `/desktop`: the download question is a standard list instead of y/n
- Changed `ExitWorktree` to ask before removing a worktree that may hold unsaved work; refused in don't-ask mode or with nobody to answer, unless an allow rule, auto or bypass permissions mode allows it
- Changed `claude mcp add --scope project` to stop, instead of overwriting the file, when `.mcp.json` lists its servers at the top level with no `mcpServers` key
- Changed the arrow keys on most permission prompts to stop at No instead of wrapping around; a number past the last answer moves to No
- Changed path checks to refuse some symbolic links
- Changed what counts as inside a working directory, so some paths now ask for permission
- Changed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to ask about more Bash commands in bypass and auto modes, and to deny some in auto mode
- Changed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to refuse more Bash commands that name a path under a Read or Edit deny rule, where it used to ask
- Changed auto mode's notice about falling back to billed classifier requests to say that an upcoming release removes the fallback; each action it would have checked will be asked about or denied
- Changed auto mode to ignore more allow rules that run any package, like `Bash(pnpm dlx *)`, and path or version forms of ones it already ignored (`/usr/bin/npm run:*`); the safety check decides those
- Changed `/sandbox` and most `/config` value lists to be unnumbered outside screen reader mode; use the arrow keys and Enter
- Changed Bash commands whose variables expand to very long text to be denied, with a message that says to use shorter values or a file
- Changed the PowerShell tool to ask before one more command, even under a rule naming it; if nothing answers, it's refused unless a whole-tool rule, auto mode or bypass permissions mode allows it
- Changed a subagent resumed by a sibling's message to follow the session's permission settings; it may now ask, or be refused where nobody can answer
- Changed `--worktree` with a relative `--add-dir` beside the launch folder to give the Bash sandbox that folder, not one beside the worktree
- Changed some `--worktree` starts with a relative `--add-dir` above the launch folder, such as `..`, to give the Bash sandbox, and a `--bg` session, only the worktree
- Changed Claude in Chrome to refuse uploading some credential files; attach those to the page yourself
- Changed artifact approval in organizations that require it for each new artifact: an artifact that only a plugin created or allowed can be refused
- Changed sessions with nobody to ask to refuse a new artifact at once, with no permission prompt, in organizations that require approval of each one
- Changed the Artifact tool to refuse calls once settings turn Artifacts off, in sessions already running too
- Changed the Artifact publish prompt to stop offering "don't ask again" in subagents and after a background task result, someone else's message or a compaction
- Changed `claude plugin eval` to keep its deny rules over a plugin's permission hook, and to flag calls the hook let through
- Changed MCP server logs to record the mode, action, and field names of elicitation requests and hook answers, not their full contents
- Changed most prompts to ignore answers other than Esc for a moment after resuming with `fg`
- Changed Code Mode to no longer refuse to start when an installed mod hooks tool calls; an administrator can still keep Code Mode off in managed settings
- Changed subagents launched without a model to stay on the model they started on when resumed, including after `/model`
- Changed the first subagent on a model to wait up to 1.5 seconds (10 in `claude -p`) for that model's settings from Anthropic, instead of starting without them
- Changed restarted background subagents, and turns that start by themselves, to wait for plugins to load
- Changed prompt history to leave out most launch prompts of sessions that another Claude Code session started, such as `claude --bg` run by Claude
- Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to be written from short notes, not the whole conversation, using far fewer tokens
- Changed non-interactive (`-p`) mode to run fewer git commands before the first request
- Changed first-run setup to skip terminal setup in remote VS Code, Cursor and Devin Desktop sessions, where it cannot change settings
- Changed fullscreen text selection to leave out the glyph of system, thinking and inbound message lines
- Changed Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to ignore more of a repository's flag and plugin delivery settings; its `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` now acts at most as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
- [VSCode] Added "Claude Code: Add to Chat" to the Explorer's right-click menu, which @-mentions the selected files and folders in the chat
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt not showing the reason that a PreToolUse hook gives when it asks for confirmation (anthropics/claude-code#85950)
- [VSCode] Fixed long tool and file names being cut off in a permission prompt's title
- [VSCode] Fixed a terminal session's diff showing the previous proposed edit after you typed in it and Claude edited the same file again
- [VSCode] Fixed Escape also stopping Claude's response when it closes the feedback or "Build a custom style" dialog, the @-mention menu, the model, mode or "+" menu, or another popup
- [VSCode] Improved speed when Claude makes several edits in a row: queued edits share one wait for new problems; a problem may be reported with a later edit
- [VSCode] Improved @-mention file search speed in large workspaces when `rg` is on your `PATH`; results now rank much as in the terminal, with less tolerance for typos
- [VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker is ready at once in folders opened for the first time, empty windows and worktrees, except on third-party providers
- [VSCode] Changed a chat edit's diff to stay open and keep asking for approval when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt
- [VSCode] Removed unused tools from the IDE connection (openFile, saveDocument, getOpenEditors and related)

rawIngestions.titleRaw: huggingface/transformers v5.24.0 released
rawIngestions.contentRaw: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. It uses a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved sliding-window and full attention layers. A shared block of layers is applied repeatedly, so Dory can spend more compute per token. The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dory) | [Paper (nGPT)](https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.01131) * Add Dory model support (#50099) by @shan18 ### HY4-VL HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation. It supports dynamic-resolution visual inputs and uses multimodal rotary position embeddings (mRoPE) to represent temporal and spatial positions. It builds on the Qwen2-VL design and shares its vision patch merger with HunYuan-VL. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4_vl) * Add HY4-VL (#50877) by @vasqu ### Omnilingual ASR Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages. Each model pairs a Wav2Vec2-style audio encoder with one of two heads: * **CTC** (`OmniASRForCTC`): a linear projection to the vocabulary, decoded non-autoregressively with greedy CTC. * **Audio language model** (`OmniASRForConditionalGeneration`): audio embeddings are projected into a Llama decoder that generates the transcription. It optionally takes a language code (e.g. `"eng_Latn"`), which generally improves transcription quality. Both variants come in 300M, 1B, 3B and 7B sizes. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr) | [CTC Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr_ctc) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2511.09690) * Adding Omnilingual ASR models (#43265) by @ebezzam ### Lara Mini Lara Mini is a multilingual base language model from Translated with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters per token. It is a hybrid of linear-time recurrent layers, sliding-window attention and a few global attention layers, each followed by a fine-grained mixture of experts. The weights are released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (non-commercial use) in a gated repository. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lara_mini) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2611.16956) * Add Lara Mini (#50819) by @ValeGian ### SarvamMLA SarvamMLA is the architecture of Sarvam-105B, a 105B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Sarvam AI. It combines Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with sparse MoE routing: 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. It uses sigmoid routing with group-based top-k selection and YaRN rotary embeddings for contexts up to 131K tokens. The architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, with a custom configuration. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_mla) * Add SarvamMLA model (sarvamai/sarvam-105b) (#44569) by @aashay-sarvam ### SarvamMoE SarvamMoE is the architecture of Sarvam-30B, Sarvam AI's 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model. It uses grouped-query attention with QK normalization, and 128 routed experts with 6 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. The architecture is the same as GLM-4-MoE, so the auto classes load it with the GLM-4-MoE implementation and only `SarvamMoEConfig` is specific to SarvamMoE. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_moe) * Add SarvamMoE (sarvamai/sarvam-30b) (#51023) by @hmellor ### EXAONE EXAONE covers the EXAONE 3.0, EXAONE 3.5 and EXAONE Deep language models from LG AI Research. Their architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load them with `LlamaModel` and `LlamaForCausalLM`, and only `ExaoneConfig` is specific to EXAONE. The released checkpoints are renamed to the Llama names when loading and back when saving, so they no longer need `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/exaone) * Add EXAONE (#50966) by @hmellor ### Model updates * **Ling 3.1 Flash** now loads natively through `BailingHybrid`, like Ling 3.0 in v5.20.0 (#49737) by @icavan * **Beam** gains a `BeamForTokenClassification` head (#50634) by @AymenKallala ## Breaking changes ### Cache renaming: `past_key_values` / `cache_params` → `cache` (#50585, #50730) `past_key_values` and `cache_params` are renamed to `cache` across the library. The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below. * 🚨🚨 Rename `past_key_values`/`cache_params` to `cache` (#50585) by @Cyrilvallez * Bump minimal peft version for cache name compatibility (#50730) by @Cyrilvallez Attention models used to call their cache `past_key_values`, while Mamba-style and linear-attention models called it `cache_params`. Hybrid models therefore had to juggle two names for the same object. There is now a single name, `cache`, everywhere: model `forward` signatures, `generate`, `prepare_inputs_for_generation`, the masking utilities, and every `ModelOutput`. ```python # Before outputs = model(input_ids, past_key_values=past_key_values, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.past_key_values # Now outputs = model(input_ids, cache=cache, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.cache ``` * **Fully backward compatible for now**: `past_key_values=` / `cache_params=` are renamed to `cache` automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning. Model `forward` and `prepare_inputs_for_generation` accept the old names until **v5.40.0**, and `generate` accepts them until **v6.0.0**. Passing both an old name and `cache` raises a `ValueError`. * **Outputs too**: `outputs.past_key_values`, `outputs.cache_params` and `outputs["past_key_values"]` still return the cache. Output classes can also still be built with the old field names (e.g. `CausalLMOutputWithPast(past_key_values=...)`), so most remote-code models keep working unchanged. * **Custom code**: models defined outside the library should rename their arguments to `cache`. Layers now call `cache.update(key_states, value_states, layer_idx, kwargs=kwargs)`, so custom `Cache` subclasses that override `update` should accept the extra `kwargs` argument. 🚨 `peft>=0.22.0` is now required. 📚 Docs: ### Multimodal Outputs Generative multimodal models now return shared output classes (`MultimodalBaseModelOutputWithPast`, `MultimodalCausalLMOutputWithPast`, and their MoE variants) instead of one output class per model. Code that checks for a model-specific output class should switch to these. * 🚨 Multimodal Model Output for generative LMs (#50379) by @zucchini-nlp `modeling_attn_mask_utils.py` has been removed. Every function in it had been deprecated in favor of `transformers.masking_utils`. Remote-code models that still import `_prepare_4d_causal_attention_mask` or `AttentionMaskConverter` from it must move to `transformers.masking_utils`. ### Other things * Remove deprecated and unused older mask API file (#50728) by @Cyrilvallez LayoutLMv3 (and the PP-DocLayoutV2 reading-order model that shares its code) now go through the attention interface, so SDPA and flex attention are supported. The relative position bias is built once per forward pass and passed to attention as `position_bias`. * 🚨 LayoutLMv3: support SDPA through the attention interface, build the relative position bias once (#50688) by @14H034160212 ## Cache Beyond the rename, this release adds static-cache support to assisted decoding and fixes `generate` with flex attention and a static cache. `StaticCache` now allocates values with the value states' dtype, and the cache is kept under activation checkpointing when gradients are off. The `is_linear` / `is_croppable` properties are fixed for hybrid linear/full-attention models, BigBird block-sparse decoding works with a KV cache, and KV sharing is restored for the Gemma 4 assistants. * Support static cache in assisted decoding (#49415) by @jiqing-feng * Simplify cache handling in generate (#50910) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix generate with flex attention and a static cache (#50864) by @tarekziade * Allocate the StaticCache values with the value states' dtype (#49554) by @qgallouedec * Keep the cache under activation checkpointing when gradients are off (#50890) by @qgallouedec * [cache] Fix is_linear property to correctly remove hybrid layers (#51030) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix is_croppable property for mixed linear-full attention classes (#51028) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix BigBird block-sparse decoding with a KV cache (#49984) by @jiqing-feng * fix(gemma4): Restore KV sharing for the Gemma 4 assistants and their targets (#50531) by @harshaljanjani * Fix Dory vocabulary resizing, loop validation, and last-loop static caching (#50982) by @shan18 * Fix device placement in `test_bc_cache_name_{forward,generate}` (#50757) by @ydshieh * Update test_dynamic_cache_hard expected values for A10G (#50822) by @ydshieh ## Generation Generation fixes cover sampled beam search (candidates are sorted again before finalization), constrained sampling (batch IDs are preserved), `generate` on MPS with encoder-decoder models, and `TextStreamer`, which no longer drops spaces or lags on text without spaces such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `StopStringCriteria` initializes faster, and its cache now actually hits. * Restore sorting of sampled beam candidates before finalization (#50754) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(generate): preserve batch IDs in constrained sampling (#50883) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Fix generate for mps and encoder-decoder models (#51032) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix TextStreamer dropping spaces sometimes (#51036) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix long lagging when streaming text without spaces and NJK chars (#36708) by @CNSeniorious000 * Speed up StopStringCriteria init and fix its cache never hitting (#50780) by @TheNetherWatcher ## Continuous batching Continuous batching now works under `torch.inference_mode()` and finds sharded key/value projections under any decoder path. The per-token memory estimate scales with the TP size, warmup handles async and static inputs correctly, and an out-of-bounds error in the top-k processor is fixed. * [CB] Scale the per-token memory estimate by the TP size (#48566) by @qgallouedec * Continuous batching: find the sharded key/value projections under any decoder path (#50366) by @qgallouedec * Fix continuous batching under torch.inference_mode() (#50863) by @tarekziade * [CB] Re-order the warmup block so async warms both sets of inputs (#50868) by @remi-or * Wait for each warmup forward before the next one rewrites the static inputs (#50353) by @qgallouedec * Fix out-of-bounds error in continuous batching top-k processor (#50282) by @khush-patel-09 * [CB] Replace test prompts with less ambiguous ones (#50876) by @remi-or ## Chat templates, parsing and serving Chat parsing gets a new `python-call-list` content parser, better handling of bare keys and duplicate XML arguments, and three further parser fixes. `apply_chat_template` accepts message objects, and assistant masks are correct with left truncation. `transformers serve` handles a missing Hub cache, lists loaded models in `/v1/models`, keeps local paths containing `@`, and keeps assistant content when `tool_calls` is empty. * [Chat Parsing] Add `python-call-list` content parser (#50619) by @nico-martin * [Chat Parsing] Quote bare keys that have whitespace around them with `unquoted_keys` (#50917) by @gagan-baghel * [Chat Parsing] Preserve array values when merging duplicate XML arguments (#50760) by @crunz-ailab * Fix three chat parsing bugs (#50655) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix apply_chat_template with message objects (#50818) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix assistant tokens mask with left truncation (#50758) by @yibol9768-alt * fix(chat templating): isolate concurrent assistant tracking (#50673) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Just a small improvement in jinja (#50635) by @zucchini-nlp * Accept argument types in parentheses in get_json_schema docstrings (#50745) by @miinimal * [serve] Handle missing Hub cache and include loaded models in /v1/models (#50663) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Preserve local model paths containing '@' in ModelManager (#50662) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Keep assistant content when tool_calls is null or empty (#50707) by @AabhasK ## Pipelines Multimodal pipelines now accept media-only inputs and string assistant prefills, keep Mistral prefills in Voxtral, stop mutating generation kwargs, and return chat messages as `input_text` when returning tensors. `pipeline` also respects a `device_map` that targets a single device. * fix(pipelines): support media-only inputs in AnyToAnyPipeline (#50856) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): support string assistant prefill in multimodal full-t… (#50679) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix: preserve Mistral prefill in Voxtral and multimodal pipelines (#50624) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): avoid mutating multimodal generation kwargs (#50786) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Return the chat messages as input_text when multimodal pipelines return tensors (#50816) by @burrows99 * Fix `pipeline` ignoring `device_map` when it targets a single device (#50645) by @wanhakim ## Vision Vision fixes cover Muse Glimmer's embedding order, GotOCR2 and Emu3 image sizes, Kimi video inputs, NemotronH Omni video forwarding, SAM3 RoPE precision in bf16, and DETR-family configs with `dilation=None`. SigLIP2 and LFM2-VL now process all images at once with tensor ops. Flash Attention is turned off for multimodal models whose image mask it would drop. * Fix Muse Glimmer vision embedding order (#50847) by @sid-rp * Fix GotOCR2 image size (#50810) by @guarin * Fix Emu3 image sizes after channel format conversion (#50615) by @stefanielizeth73-art * Kimi video fix (#50633) by @zucchini-nlp * Fix NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 video forwarding and MTP vision norm weight conversion (#49839) by @meatybobby * Keep SAM3's RoPE positions in fp32 when loading in bf16 (#50938) by @qgallouedec * Fix loading DETR-family configs that store dilation=None (#50934) by @sibisrinivasb * SigLIP2: compute the position-embedding resize for all images with tensor ops (#50736) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: run the projector on all images at once (#50734) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: integration expectations after #50734 (A10, MI300X) (#50923) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * Turn off Flash Attention support for multimodal models whose image mask it drops (#50724) by @albertvillanova ## Audio Audio fixes cover the OmniASR CTC blank token, Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs, Qwen3-ASR's `truncation=False` default, PeAudioVideo loading with timm 1.0.31, and the audio training examples. * Fix OmniASR CTC blank token ID (#51040) by @taking-lying-flat * Add missing past_key_values deprecation decorator to OmniASRForCondit… (#50983) by @RyanMullins * Fix Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs forwarding (#50616) by @remote-controlled-man * Restore `truncation=False` default for Qwen3-ASR audio (#50740) by @hmellor * Fixes PeAudioVideo model loading with timm 1.0.31. In that version, t… (#50862) by @sywangyi * FIx audio training examples. (#50672) by @ebezzam ## Quantization Dequantized models are now saved without the quantizer's weight conversions, and the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint are cast to the model's dtype. The quantization docs also get a standard template for each method. * Save dequantized models without the quantizer's weight conversions (#50271) by @qgallouedec * Cast the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint to the model's dtype (#50595) by @qgallouedec * Update inkling2 quant config (#50829) by @guarin * [docs] Standard template for quantization methods (#50848) by @stevhliu ## Parallelization FSDP2 modules are resharded before the optimizer is created, pipeline parallelism spreads layers more evenly, and TP sharding of tied weights is fixed. * Reshard FSDP2 modules before creating the optimizer (#50535) by @qgallouedec * [perf] Spread layer over PP more evenly (#50693) by @francesco-bertolotti * Fixes an issue related to TP sharding of tied weights (#50272) by @tengomucho ## Exporters Exported ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without `trust_remote_code`. Pickled `.pt2` programs, which can run arbitrary code when loaded, now require `trust_remote_code=True`. * Exporters: ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without trust_remote_code (#50886) by release.name: Release v5.24.0
release.body: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. It uses a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved sliding-window and full attention layers. A shared block of layers is applied repeatedly, so Dory can spend more compute per token. The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dory) | [Paper (nGPT)](https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.01131) * Add Dory model support (#50099) by @shan18 ### HY4-VL HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation. It supports dynamic-resolution visual inputs and uses multimodal rotary position embeddings (mRoPE) to represent temporal and spatial positions. It builds on the Qwen2-VL design and shares its vision patch merger with HunYuan-VL. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4_vl) * Add HY4-VL (#50877) by @vasqu ### Omnilingual ASR Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages. Each model pairs a Wav2Vec2-style audio encoder with one of two heads: * **CTC** (`OmniASRForCTC`): a linear projection to the vocabulary, decoded non-autoregressively with greedy CTC. * **Audio language model** (`OmniASRForConditionalGeneration`): audio embeddings are projected into a Llama decoder that generates the transcription. It optionally takes a language code (e.g. `"eng_Latn"`), which generally improves transcription quality. Both variants come in 300M, 1B, 3B and 7B sizes. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr) | [CTC Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr_ctc) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2511.09690) * Adding Omnilingual ASR models (#43265) by @ebezzam ### Lara Mini Lara Mini is a multilingual base language model from Translated with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters per token. It is a hybrid of linear-time recurrent layers, sliding-window attention and a few global attention layers, each followed by a fine-grained mixture of experts. The weights are released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (non-commercial use) in a gated repository. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lara_mini) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2611.16956) * Add Lara Mini (#50819) by @ValeGian ### SarvamMLA SarvamMLA is the architecture of Sarvam-105B, a 105B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Sarvam AI. It combines Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with sparse MoE routing: 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. It uses sigmoid routing with group-based top-k selection and YaRN rotary embeddings for contexts up to 131K tokens. The architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, with a custom configuration. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_mla) * Add SarvamMLA model (sarvamai/sarvam-105b) (#44569) by @aashay-sarvam ### SarvamMoE SarvamMoE is the architecture of Sarvam-30B, Sarvam AI's 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model. It uses grouped-query attention with QK normalization, and 128 routed experts with 6 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. The architecture is the same as GLM-4-MoE, so the auto classes load it with the GLM-4-MoE implementation and only `SarvamMoEConfig` is specific to SarvamMoE. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_moe) * Add SarvamMoE (sarvamai/sarvam-30b) (#51023) by @hmellor ### EXAONE EXAONE covers the EXAONE 3.0, EXAONE 3.5 and EXAONE Deep language models from LG AI Research. Their architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load them with `LlamaModel` and `LlamaForCausalLM`, and only `ExaoneConfig` is specific to EXAONE. The released checkpoints are renamed to the Llama names when loading and back when saving, so they no longer need `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/exaone) * Add EXAONE (#50966) by @hmellor ### Model updates * **Ling 3.1 Flash** now loads natively through `BailingHybrid`, like Ling 3.0 in v5.20.0 (#49737) by @icavan * **Beam** gains a `BeamForTokenClassification` head (#50634) by @AymenKallala ## Breaking changes ### Cache renaming: `past_key_values` / `cache_params` → `cache` (#50585, #50730) `past_key_values` and `cache_params` are renamed to `cache` across the library. The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below. * 🚨🚨 Rename `past_key_values`/`cache_params` to `cache` (#50585) by @Cyrilvallez * Bump minimal peft version for cache name compatibility (#50730) by @Cyrilvallez Attention models used to call their cache `past_key_values`, while Mamba-style and linear-attention models called it `cache_params`. Hybrid models therefore had to juggle two names for the same object. There is now a single name, `cache`, everywhere: model `forward` signatures, `generate`, `prepare_inputs_for_generation`, the masking utilities, and every `ModelOutput`. ```python # Before outputs = model(input_ids, past_key_values=past_key_values, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.past_key_values # Now outputs = model(input_ids, cache=cache, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.cache ``` * **Fully backward compatible for now**: `past_key_values=` / `cache_params=` are renamed to `cache` automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning. Model `forward` and `prepare_inputs_for_generation` accept the old names until **v5.40.0**, and `generate` accepts them until **v6.0.0**. Passing both an old name and `cache` raises a `ValueError`. * **Outputs too**: `outputs.past_key_values`, `outputs.cache_params` and `outputs["past_key_values"]` still return the cache. Output classes can also still be built with the old field names (e.g. `CausalLMOutputWithPast(past_key_values=...)`), so most remote-code models keep working unchanged. * **Custom code**: models defined outside the library should rename their arguments to `cache`. Layers now call `cache.update(key_states, value_states, layer_idx, kwargs=kwargs)`, so custom `Cache` subclasses that override `update` should accept the extra `kwargs` argument. 🚨 `peft>=0.22.0` is now required. 📚 Docs: ### Multimodal Outputs Generative multimodal models now return shared output classes (`MultimodalBaseModelOutputWithPast`, `MultimodalCausalLMOutputWithPast`, and their MoE variants) instead of one output class per model. Code that checks for a model-specific output class should switch to these. * 🚨 Multimodal Model Output for generative LMs (#50379) by @zucchini-nlp `modeling_attn_mask_utils.py` has been removed. Every function in it had been deprecated in favor of `transformers.masking_utils`. Remote-code models that still import `_prepare_4d_causal_attention_mask` or `AttentionMaskConverter` from it must move to `transformers.masking_utils`. ### Other things * Remove deprecated and unused older mask API file (#50728) by @Cyrilvallez LayoutLMv3 (and the PP-DocLayoutV2 reading-order model that shares its code) now go through the attention interface, so SDPA and flex attention are supported. The relative position bias is built once per forward pass and passed to attention as `position_bias`. * 🚨 LayoutLMv3: support SDPA through the attention interface, build the relative position bias once (#50688) by @14H034160212 ## Cache Beyond the rename, this release adds static-cache support to assisted decoding and fixes `generate` with flex attention and a static cache. `StaticCache` now allocates values with the value states' dtype, and the cache is kept under activation checkpointing when gradients are off. The `is_linear` / `is_croppable` properties are fixed for hybrid linear/full-attention models, BigBird block-sparse decoding works with a KV cache, and KV sharing is restored for the Gemma 4 assistants. * Support static cache in assisted decoding (#49415) by @jiqing-feng * Simplify cache handling in generate (#50910) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix generate with flex attention and a static cache (#50864) by @tarekziade * Allocate the StaticCache values with the value states' dtype (#49554) by @qgallouedec * Keep the cache under activation checkpointing when gradients are off (#50890) by @qgallouedec * [cache] Fix is_linear property to correctly remove hybrid layers (#51030) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix is_croppable property for mixed linear-full attention classes (#51028) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix BigBird block-sparse decoding with a KV cache (#49984) by @jiqing-feng * fix(gemma4): Restore KV sharing for the Gemma 4 assistants and their targets (#50531) by @harshaljanjani * Fix Dory vocabulary resizing, loop validation, and last-loop static caching (#50982) by @shan18 * Fix device placement in `test_bc_cache_name_{forward,generate}` (#50757) by @ydshieh * Update test_dynamic_cache_hard expected values for A10G (#50822) by @ydshieh ## Generation Generation fixes cover sampled beam search (candidates are sorted again before finalization), constrained sampling (batch IDs are preserved), `generate` on MPS with encoder-decoder models, and `TextStreamer`, which no longer drops spaces or lags on text without spaces such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `StopStringCriteria` initializes faster, and its cache now actually hits. * Restore sorting of sampled beam candidates before finalization (#50754) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(generate): preserve batch IDs in constrained sampling (#50883) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Fix generate for mps and encoder-decoder models (#51032) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix TextStreamer dropping spaces sometimes (#51036) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix long lagging when streaming text without spaces and NJK chars (#36708) by @CNSeniorious000 * Speed up StopStringCriteria init and fix its cache never hitting (#50780) by @TheNetherWatcher ## Continuous batching Continuous batching now works under `torch.inference_mode()` and finds sharded key/value projections under any decoder path. The per-token memory estimate scales with the TP size, warmup handles async and static inputs correctly, and an out-of-bounds error in the top-k processor is fixed. * [CB] Scale the per-token memory estimate by the TP size (#48566) by @qgallouedec * Continuous batching: find the sharded key/value projections under any decoder path (#50366) by @qgallouedec * Fix continuous batching under torch.inference_mode() (#50863) by @tarekziade * [CB] Re-order the warmup block so async warms both sets of inputs (#50868) by @remi-or * Wait for each warmup forward before the next one rewrites the static inputs (#50353) by @qgallouedec * Fix out-of-bounds error in continuous batching top-k processor (#50282) by @khush-patel-09 * [CB] Replace test prompts with less ambiguous ones (#50876) by @remi-or ## Chat templates, parsing and serving Chat parsing gets a new `python-call-list` content parser, better handling of bare keys and duplicate XML arguments, and three further parser fixes. `apply_chat_template` accepts message objects, and assistant masks are correct with left truncation. `transformers serve` handles a missing Hub cache, lists loaded models in `/v1/models`, keeps local paths containing `@`, and keeps assistant content when `tool_calls` is empty. * [Chat Parsing] Add `python-call-list` content parser (#50619) by @nico-martin * [Chat Parsing] Quote bare keys that have whitespace around them with `unquoted_keys` (#50917) by @gagan-baghel * [Chat Parsing] Preserve array values when merging duplicate XML arguments (#50760) by @crunz-ailab * Fix three chat parsing bugs (#50655) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix apply_chat_template with message objects (#50818) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix assistant tokens mask with left truncation (#50758) by @yibol9768-alt * fix(chat templating): isolate concurrent assistant tracking (#50673) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Just a small improvement in jinja (#50635) by @zucchini-nlp * Accept argument types in parentheses in get_json_schema docstrings (#50745) by @miinimal * [serve] Handle missing Hub cache and include loaded models in /v1/models (#50663) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Preserve local model paths containing '@' in ModelManager (#50662) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Keep assistant content when tool_calls is null or empty (#50707) by @AabhasK ## Pipelines Multimodal pipelines now accept media-only inputs and string assistant prefills, keep Mistral prefills in Voxtral, stop mutating generation kwargs, and return chat messages as `input_text` when returning tensors. `pipeline` also respects a `device_map` that targets a single device. * fix(pipelines): support media-only inputs in AnyToAnyPipeline (#50856) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): support string assistant prefill in multimodal full-t… (#50679) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix: preserve Mistral prefill in Voxtral and multimodal pipelines (#50624) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): avoid mutating multimodal generation kwargs (#50786) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Return the chat messages as input_text when multimodal pipelines return tensors (#50816) by @burrows99 * Fix `pipeline` ignoring `device_map` when it targets a single device (#50645) by @wanhakim ## Vision Vision fixes cover Muse Glimmer's embedding order, GotOCR2 and Emu3 image sizes, Kimi video inputs, NemotronH Omni video forwarding, SAM3 RoPE precision in bf16, and DETR-family configs with `dilation=None`. SigLIP2 and LFM2-VL now process all images at once with tensor ops. Flash Attention is turned off for multimodal models whose image mask it would drop. * Fix Muse Glimmer vision embedding order (#50847) by @sid-rp * Fix GotOCR2 image size (#50810) by @guarin * Fix Emu3 image sizes after channel format conversion (#50615) by @stefanielizeth73-art * Kimi video fix (#50633) by @zucchini-nlp * Fix NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 video forwarding and MTP vision norm weight conversion (#49839) by @meatybobby * Keep SAM3's RoPE positions in fp32 when loading in bf16 (#50938) by @qgallouedec * Fix loading DETR-family configs that store dilation=None (#50934) by @sibisrinivasb * SigLIP2: compute the position-embedding resize for all images with tensor ops (#50736) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: run the projector on all images at once (#50734) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: integration expectations after #50734 (A10, MI300X) (#50923) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * Turn off Flash Attention support for multimodal models whose image mask it drops (#50724) by @albertvillanova ## Audio Audio fixes cover the OmniASR CTC blank token, Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs, Qwen3-ASR's `truncation=False` default, PeAudioVideo loading with timm 1.0.31, and the audio training examples. * Fix OmniASR CTC blank token ID (#51040) by @taking-lying-flat * Add missing past_key_values deprecation decorator to OmniASRForCondit… (#50983) by @RyanMullins * Fix Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs forwarding (#50616) by @remote-controlled-man * Restore `truncation=False` default for Qwen3-ASR audio (#50740) by @hmellor * Fixes PeAudioVideo model loading with timm 1.0.31. In that version, t… (#50862) by @sywangyi * FIx audio training examples. (#50672) by @ebezzam ## Quantization Dequantized models are now saved without the quantizer's weight conversions, and the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint are cast to the model's dtype. The quantization docs also get a standard template for each method. * Save dequantized models without the quantizer's weight conversions (#50271) by @qgallouedec * Cast the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint to the model's dtype (#50595) by @qgallouedec * Update inkling2 quant config (#50829) by @guarin * [docs] Standard template for quantization methods (#50848) by @stevhliu ## Parallelization FSDP2 modules are resharded before the optimizer is created, pipeline parallelism spreads layers more evenly, and TP sharding of tied weights is fixed. * Reshard FSDP2 modules before creating the optimizer (#50535) by @qgallouedec * [perf] Spread layer over PP more evenly (#50693) by @francesco-bertolotti * Fixes an issue related to TP sharding of tied weights (#50272) by @tengomucho ## Exporters Exported ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without `trust_remote_code`. Pickled `.pt2` programs, which can run arbitrary code when loaded, now require `trust_remote_code=True`. * Exporters: ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without trust_remote_code (#50886) by
